progress_measure_verified_value_one.message: $COUNT$ word recalled after a gap of 3 weeks or more, with no miss since.
progress_measure_verified_value_one.description: Result of the verified-known measurement, singular. $1 is the number of words.

progress_measure_verified_value_other.message: $COUNT$ words recalled after a gap of 3 weeks or more, with no miss since.
progress_measure_verified_value_other.description: Result of the verified-known measurement, plural. $1 is the number of words.

progress_measure_verified_none.message: No word has been recalled after a 3-week gap yet.
progress_measure_verified_none.description: Result of the verified-known measurement when there are none yet.

progress_measure_verified_why.message: This counts lasting learning, not words seen. It grows when words survive long gaps between reviews.
progress_measure_verified_why.description: One-sentence explanation under the verified-known measurement.

progress_measure_next_day_title.description: Title of a measurement in the "Is this working?" list on My words.

progress_measure_next_day_value_one.message: $PERCENT$ of new words recalled the day after you met them ($COUNT$ review).
progress_measure_next_day_value_one.description: Result of the next-day recall measurement, singular. $1 is the number of reviews, $2 a percentage.

progress_measure_next_day_value_other.message: $PERCENT$ of new words recalled the day after you met them ($COUNT$ reviews).
progress_measure_next_day_value_other.description: Result of the next-day recall measurement, plural. $1 is the number of reviews, $2 a percentage.

progress_measure_next_day_few_one.message: Not enough data yet: $COUNT$ first review made the day after introduction; 10 are needed.
progress_measure_next_day_few_one.description: Next-day recall measurement with too little data, singular. $1 is the number of reviews so far.

progress_measure_next_day_few_other.message: Not enough data yet: $COUNT$ first reviews made the day after introduction; 10 are needed.
progress_measure_next_day_few_other.description: Next-day recall measurement with too little data, plural. $1 is the number of reviews so far.

progress_measure_next_day_why.message: Low next-day recall means words arrive faster than they stick; fewer new words a day, or reviewing the next day, raises it.
progress_measure_next_day_why.description: One-sentence explanation under the next-day recall measurement.

progress_measure_retention_title.description: Title of a measurement in the "Is this working?" list on My words.

progress_measure_retention_value_one.message: $RATE$ recalled after gaps of 21 days or more, against a target of $TARGET$ ($COUNT$ review).
progress_measure_retention_value_one.description: Result of the long-retention measurement, singular. $1 is the number of reviews, $2 and $3 percentages.

progress_measure_retention_value_other.message: $RATE$ recalled after gaps of 21 days or more, against a target of $TARGET$ ($COUNT$ reviews).
progress_measure_retention_value_other.description: Result of the long-retention measurement, plural. $1 is the number of reviews, $2 and $3 percentages.

progress_measure_retention_few_one.message: Not enough data yet: $COUNT$ review after a 21-day gap; 10 are needed.
progress_measure_retention_few_one.description: Long-retention measurement with too little data, singular. $1 is the number of reviews so far.

progress_measure_retention_few_other.message: Not enough data yet: $COUNT$ reviews after a 21-day gap; 10 are needed.
progress_measure_retention_few_other.description: Long-retention measurement with too little data, plural. $1 is the number of reviews so far.

progress_measure_retention_why.message: Well below the target means the schedule is too optimistic for you; near it means the spacing is working.
progress_measure_retention_why.description: One-sentence explanation under the long-retention measurement.

progress_measure_calibration_title.description: Title of a measurement in the "Is this working?" list on My words.

progress_measure_calibration_bucket.description: One predicted-probability band in the calibration measurement: the predicted range, the share actually recalled, and how many reviews fell in it. Bands are joined with "; ".

progress_measure_calibration_beats.message: $BANDS$. The scheduler beats a constant guess.
progress_measure_calibration_beats.description: Result of the calibration measurement when the scheduler beats a constant guess. $1 is the list of bands.

progress_measure_calibration_no_beat.message: $BANDS$. The scheduler does not beat a constant guess.
progress_measure_calibration_no_beat.description: Result of the calibration measurement when the scheduler does not beat a constant guess. $1 is the list of bands.

progress_measure_calibration_few_one.message: Not enough data yet: $COUNT$ scheduled review; 50 are needed, and a fair test needs a few hundred.
progress_measure_calibration_few_one.description: Calibration measurement with too little data, singular. $1 is the number of reviews so far.

progress_measure_calibration_few_other.message: Not enough data yet: $COUNT$ scheduled reviews; 50 are needed, and a fair test needs a few hundred.
progress_measure_calibration_few_other.description: Calibration measurement with too little data, plural. $1 is the number of reviews so far.

progress_measure_calibration_why.message: If predictions do not beat a constant guess after a few hundred reviews, the scheduler is not fitting your memory.
progress_measure_calibration_why.description: One-sentence explanation under the calibration measurement.

progress_measure_hard_title.description: Title of a measurement in the "Is this working?" list on My words.

progress_measure_hard_few_one.message: Not enough data yet: $COUNT$ rated review; 20 are needed.
progress_measure_hard_few_one.description: Hard-words measurement with too little data, singular. $1 is the number of rated reviews so far.

progress_measure_hard_few_other.message: Not enough data yet: $COUNT$ rated reviews; 20 are needed.
progress_measure_hard_few_other.description: Hard-words measurement with too little data, plural. $1 is the number of rated reviews so far.

progress_measure_hard_value_one.message: $COUNT$ word missed 4 or more times after a gap of a day or more: $WORDS$.
progress_measure_hard_value_one.description: Hard-words measurement result, singular. $2 is a comma-separated list of the words.

progress_measure_hard_value_other.message: $COUNT$ words missed 4 or more times after a gap of a day or more: $WORDS$.
progress_measure_hard_value_other.description: Hard-words measurement result, plural. $2 is a comma-separated list of the words.

progress_measure_hard_none.message: No word has been missed 4 or more times.
progress_measure_hard_none.description: Hard-words measurement result when there are none.

progress_measure_hard_why.message: Words that keep slipping need a new context or a memory aid; Reset starts one over.
progress_measure_hard_why.description: One-sentence explanation under the hard-words measurement. "Reset" is the label of a button on My words.

progress_measure_exposure_title.description: Title of a measurement in the "Is this working?" list on My words.

progress_measure_exposure_value_one.message: Your learning words were met on a median of $COUNT$ day; $REACHED$ of $WORDS$ reached 8 different days.
progress_measure_exposure_value_one.description: Reading-exposure measurement result, singular. $1 is the median number of days, $2 and $3 are word counts.

progress_measure_exposure_value_other.message: Your learning words were met on a median of $COUNT$ days; $REACHED$ of $WORDS$ reached 8 different days.
progress_measure_exposure_value_other.description: Reading-exposure measurement result, plural. $1 is the median number of days, $2 and $3 are word counts.

progress_measure_exposure_none.message: Not enough data yet: no words are being learned.
progress_measure_exposure_none.description: Reading-exposure measurement when no word is being learned.

progress_measure_exposure_why.message: Words met on 8 or more different days stick far better; reading on more days moves this.
progress_measure_exposure_why.description: One-sentence explanation under the reading-exposure measurement.

progress_measure_workload_title.description: Title of a measurement in the "Is this working?" list on My words.

progress_measure_workload_value.message: $RATE$ reviews a day over the last 30 days.
progress_measure_workload_value.description: Workload measurement result. $1 is the average number of reviews a day.

progress_measure_workload_value_seconds.message: $RATE$ reviews a day over the last 30 days, about $SECONDS$ seconds each.
progress_measure_workload_value_seconds.description: Workload measurement result with a typical time per review. $1 is reviews a day, $2 is seconds.

progress_measure_workload_none.message: No reviews in the last 30 days.
progress_measure_workload_none.description: Workload measurement when there were no reviews.

progress_measure_workload_why.message: If this feels heavy, lower the new words per day in Settings; reviews shrink as intervals grow.
progress_measure_workload_why.description: One-sentence explanation under the workload measurement. "Settings" is the name of the settings page.

review_title.description: Browser tab title of the review page. "Lang Weave" is the product name.

review_heading.description: Main heading of the review page.

review_intro.message: Say each English prompt in $LANGUAGE$, then reveal the answer and rate your recall. Reading sightings do not count as reviews.
review_intro.description: Introduction under the heading of the review page. $1 is the name of the language being learned.

review_target_language.description: Placeholder for the language name on the review page, shown until the real language name loads. Replaces $LANGUAGE$ in the review page text.

review_loading.description: Status text on the review page while the queue loads.

review_done_heading.description: Heading of the review page after the learner finishes the cards that were due.

review_say_this.description: Label above an English prompt on a review card. $1 is the name of the language being learned.

review_reveal.description: Button that shows the answer on a review card. $1 is the label of the keyboard shortcut key.

review_key_space.description: Label of the Space key, shown inside the Reveal answer button as a keyboard hint.

review_how_well.message: How well did you recall it? Press 1 to 4, or Enter for the highlighted choice.
review_how_well.description: Question above the four rating buttons on a review card. Refers to the keys 1 to 4 and Enter.

review_rating_again.description: Rating button: the learner did not recall the word. $1 is the shortcut key number.

review_rating_hard.description: Rating button: the learner recalled the word with difficulty. $1 is the shortcut key number.

review_rating_medium.description: Rating button: the learner recalled the word after some effort. $1 is the shortcut key number.

review_rating_easy.description: Rating button: the learner recalled the word easily. $1 is the shortcut key number.

review_known.description: Button on a review card that marks the word as already known.

review_rating_help.message: Again returns in 10 minutes. For a new word, Hard returns in a day, Medium in 2 days and Easy in 8 days; after that, intervals grow with each successful recall. With gradual learning on, Already know waits for one later check before it counts as verified, and three Easy ratings move a word to occasional maintenance reviews.
review_rating_help.description: Help text under the rating buttons explaining when each rating brings the word back. Names the buttons Again, Hard, Medium, Easy and Already know.

review_reload.description: Button on the review page that reloads the review queue after an error.

review_unavailable.description: Error shown on the review page when the extension's background worker does not answer.

review_failed.description: Error shown on the review page when an action fails without a more specific message.

review_counts.description: Status line on the review page: cards due and new words available to add.

review_counts_returned_one.message: $DUE$ due · $NEW$ available to add · $COUNT$ word returned from retirement to be verified
review_counts_returned_one.description: Status line on the review page when one retired word has returned to be verified. $1 is the number of returned words.

review_counts_returned_other.message: $DUE$ due · $NEW$ available to add · $COUNT$ words returned from retirement to be verified
review_counts_returned_other.description: Status line on the review page when several retired words have returned to be verified. $1 is the number of returned words.

review_introduce_one.description: Button on the review page that adds one new word to the queue.

review_introduce_other.description: Button on the review page that adds several new words to the queue. $1 is how many (at most 5).

review_pronunciation.description: Pronunciation hint shown under the revealed answer on a review card.

review_empty_new.message: No reviews due. Add a few words when you are ready.
review_empty_new.description: Review page message when no card is due but new words can be added.

review_empty_caught_up.message: You are caught up. Come back when a card is due.
review_empty_caught_up.description: Review page message when no card is due and no new words are available.

review_completed_one.description: Summary on the review page after finishing, singular. $1 is the number of reviews in this session.

review_completed_other.description: Summary on the review page after finishing, plural. $1 is the number of reviews in this session.

review_card_position.description: Progress line above a review card.

review_reviewing.description: Line on the review page naming the language being reviewed.

review_next_session_today_one.message: Next review from this session: today from $TIME$, $COUNT$ word.
review_next_session_today_one.description: After finishing: when this session's earliest card returns, later today, singular. $1 is the number of words returning that day, $2 a local time.

review_next_session_today_other.message: Next review from this session: today from $TIME$, $COUNT$ words.
review_next_session_today_other.description: After finishing: when this session's earliest card returns, later today, plural. $1 is the number of words returning that day, $2 a local time.

review_next_session_tomorrow_one.message: Next review from this session: tomorrow, $COUNT$ word.
review_next_session_tomorrow_one.description: After finishing: this session's earliest card returns tomorrow, singular. $1 is the number of words returning that day.

review_next_session_tomorrow_other.message: Next review from this session: tomorrow, $COUNT$ words.
review_next_session_tomorrow_other.description: After finishing: this session's earliest card returns tomorrow, plural. $1 is the number of words returning that day.

review_next_session_on_one.message: Next review from this session: on $DAY$, $COUNT$ word.
review_next_session_on_one.description: After finishing: this session's earliest card returns on a later day, singular. $1 is the number of words returning that day, $2 a weekday name or a date.

review_next_session_on_other.message: Next review from this session: on $DAY$, $COUNT$ words.
review_next_session_on_other.description: After finishing: this session's earliest card returns on a later day, plural. $1 is the number of words returning that day, $2 a weekday name or a date.

review_deck_empty.message: No future reviews in this deck.
review_deck_empty.description: After finishing: nothing is scheduled in the deck.

review_deck_today_one.description: After finishing: the deck's next review is later today, singular. $1 is the number of words, $2 a local time.

review_deck_today_other.description: After finishing: the deck's next review is later today, plural. $1 is the number of words, $2 a local time.

review_deck_tomorrow_one.description: After finishing: the deck's next review is tomorrow, singular. $1 is the number of words.

review_deck_tomorrow_other.description: After finishing: the deck's next review is tomorrow, plural. $1 is the number of words.

review_deck_later_one.description: After finishing: the deck's next review is on a later date, singular. $1 is the number of words, $2 a date.

review_deck_later_other.description: After finishing: the deck's next review is on a later date, plural. $1 is the number of words, $2 a date.

words_title.description: Browser tab title of the My words page. "Lang Weave" is the product name.

words_heading.description: Main heading of the My words page, which lists the learner's words and progress.

words_progress_heading.description: Heading of the progress section on My words.

words_stages_note.message: Words by stage, from the pack and your active entries (archived entries are not counted):
words_stages_note.description: Intro line above the per-stage word counts on My words. "Pack" is the bundled word list.

words_list_heading.description: Heading of the word list section on My words.

words_find.description: Label of the search box on My words. $1 is the search box itself; keep it where it belongs in the sentence.

words_search_placeholder.description: Placeholder text inside the My words search box.

words_stage_filter.description: Label of the stage filter on My words. $1 is the drop-down list itself; keep it where it belongs.

words_all_stages.description: First option of the stage filter on My words: no filtering.

words_keys.message: Arrow keys, Home and End move between words; Tab moves through each word's actions; Escape returns to search.
words_keys.description: Keyboard help under the search controls on My words.

words_working_heading.description: Heading of the section on My words that measures whether learning is working.

words_working_note.message: Measured from your own reviews on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere.
words_working_note.description: Note under the "Is this working?" heading on My words.

words_footer.message: $ENTRIES$ lists all your own words and exports them as JSON. $SETTINGS$
words_footer.description: Footer of My words. $1 is a link to the Personal entries page, $2 a link to Settings.

words_entries_link.description: Link text in the footer of My words that opens the page listing the learner's own entries.

words_settings_link.description: Link text in the footer of My words that opens the extension settings.

words_unavailable.description: Error shown on My words when the extension's background worker does not answer.

words_due_not_scheduled.description: Due status of a word that is known and not scheduled for review. Shown in the details line of a word on My words.

words_due_not_started.description: Due status of a word that has not been introduced yet. Shown in the details line of a word on My words.

words_due_now.description: Due status of a word whose review is due. Shown in the details line of a word on My words.

words_due_today_one.description: Due status of a word due later today, singular. $1 is the number of hours.

words_due_today_other.description: Due status of a word due later today, plural. $1 is the number of hours.

words_due_tomorrow.description: Due status of a word due on the next calendar day.

words_due_days_one.description: Due status of a word due in one day, singular. $1 is the number of days.

words_due_days_other.description: Due status of a word due in several days, plural. $1 is the number of days.

words_language_heading.description: Line under the My words heading naming the language whose words are listed.

words_headline_returned_one.message: $HEADLINE$ · $COUNT$ word returned from retirement to be verified
words_headline_returned_one.description: Progress headline followed by the number of retired words that returned to be verified, singular. $2 is the headline sentence.

words_headline_returned_other.message: $HEADLINE$ · $COUNT$ words returned from retirement to be verified
words_headline_returned_other.description: Progress headline followed by the number of retired words that returned to be verified, plural. $2 is the headline sentence.

words_stage_count.description: One item in the per-stage counts on My words: the stage name and how many words are in it.

words_strip_label.message: Days with reviews in the last 30 days: $COUNT$
words_strip_label.description: Screen-reader label of the 30-day activity strip on My words.

words_strip_day_one.description: Tooltip of one day in the activity strip, singular. $2 is the date, $1 the number of reviews that day.

words_strip_day_other.description: Tooltip of one day in the activity strip, plural. $2 is the date, $1 the number of reviews that day.

words_measure_title.description: Bold title of one measurement in "Is this working?" on My words; the result follows after a space.

words_gloss_sense.description: A word's English meaning followed by a short note on which sense of the word is meant.

words_tag_personal.description: Tag after a word on My words: the learner added it themselves.

words_tag_saved.description: Tag after a word on My words: the learner saved this bundled word.

words_tag_archived.description: Tag after a word on My words: the word is archived.

words_meta.description: Details line under a word on My words: its stage, when it is due, and how often it was seen while reading.

words_seen_times_one.description: Number of times a word was seen, singular. Used inside the "seen" phrase.

words_seen_times_other.description: Number of times a word was seen, plural. Used inside the "seen" phrase.

words_seen_on_one.description: How often a word was seen while reading and on how many days, singular days. $2 is the number of times, already worded.

words_seen_on_other.description: How often a word was seen while reading and on how many days, plural days. $2 is the number of times, already worded.

words_row_label.description: Screen-reader name of a word row on My words: the word, its English meaning and its stage.

words_practise.description: Button on a word row of My words: opens the review page for this word.

words_known.description: Button on a word row of My words: marks the word as already known.

words_reset.description: Button on a word row of My words: starts the confirmation to clear the word's schedule.

words_reset_group.description: Screen-reader name of the reset confirmation group for a word.

words_reset_confirm_text.message: Reset $WORD$? Its schedule, review count and "known" mark are cleared; your history stays in the measurements.
words_reset_confirm_text.description: Question shown before resetting a word on My words.

words_reset_confirm.description: Button that confirms resetting a word on My words.

words_cancel.description: Button that cancels resetting a word on My words.

words_reset_done.description: Status line after a word was reset. $2 is the word count line shown under the search box.

words_archive.description: Button on a word row of My words: archives the learner's entry.

words_unarchive.description: Button on a word row of My words: restores an archived entry.

words_more_left.description: Button at the end of the word list on My words. $1 is how many words are not shown yet.

words_count_one.description: Number of words in the list on My words, singular.

words_count_other.description: Number of words in the list on My words, plural.

words_count_of_one.description: Number of words matching the search out of all words, singular.

words_count_of_other.description: Number of words matching the search out of all words, plural.

words_no_match.description: List message on My words when the search matches nothing.

words_no_words.description: List message on My words when there are no words at all.

capture_title.description: Browser tab title of the capture confirmation page. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_retry.description: Button that reloads the pending capture draft after a failure. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_suggestions_title.description: Heading above the list of local suggestions, and the accessible name of that region. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_direction_legend.description: Legend of the two-choice group asking which language the selected text is in. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_direction_english.message: $INPUT$ English, to learn in the selected language
capture_direction_english.description: Radio option: the selection is English. $INPUT$ stands for the radio button itself and must stay in the message exactly once. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_direction_target.message: $INPUT$ Selected-language phrase, with its English meaning
capture_direction_target.description: Radio option: the selection is a phrase in the language being learned. $INPUT$ stands for the radio button itself and must stay in the message exactly once. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_label_english.description: Label of the English text field. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_label_target.description: Label of the field for the phrase in the language being learned. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_label_sense.description: Label of the optional field that distinguishes meanings of the same word. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_distinct.message: $INPUT$ This is a different sense from an existing entry
capture_distinct.description: Checkbox label: save as a separate entry even if the words match an existing one. $INPUT$ stands for the checkbox itself and must stay in the message exactly once. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_save.description: Submit button that saves the entry. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_cancel.description: Button that cancels the capture. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_entries_heading.description: Heading of the list of the user's saved personal entries. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_entry_search_label.description: Label of the search field over the personal entries. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_entry_search_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the entry search field; "target" means the language being learned. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_refresh.description: Button that reloads the personal entries list. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_export.description: Button that downloads the personal entries as a JSON file. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_expired_select.message: Capture expired. Select the word again on the page.
capture_expired_select.description: Status shown when the pending capture timed out or its keep-alive failed. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_expired_retry.message: Capture expired. Retry from the page selection.
capture_expired_retry.description: Error shown when saving without a live capture draft. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_request_failed.message: The request could not be completed.
capture_request_failed.description: Error shown when the background worker gave no usable reply. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_no_suggestions.message: No local suggestions. Enter both forms yourself.
capture_no_suggestions.description: Shown when no local suggestion matches the selected text. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_use_suggestion.description: Button on a suggestion that copies it into the form. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_origin_personal.description: Provenance label of a suggestion that is one of the user's own entries. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_origin_bundled.message: Bundled suggestion; meaning has not been independently dictionary checked
capture_origin_bundled.description: Provenance label of a suggestion that ships with the extension and has not been verified against a dictionary. Keep this honest. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_origin_local.description: Provenance label of any other local suggestion. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_review_only_default_reason.message: automatic reading is disabled for this entry
capture_review_only_default_reason.description: Fallback reason inside the "Review only" provenance note when the entry gives no reason. Lowercase: it continues a sentence. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_provenance_review_only.description: Provenance line of a suggestion that can only be reviewed, never read automatically. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_entry_archived.description: Personal entry text followed by a marker that the entry is archived. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_entry_review_only.message: Review only; automatic reading is disabled.
capture_entry_review_only.description: Note under a personal entry that can only be reviewed. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_entry_review_only_reason.message: Review only; automatic reading is disabled: $REASON$
capture_entry_review_only_reason.description: Note under a personal entry that can only be reviewed, with the reason. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_entry_none.description: Shown when the user has no personal entries. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_add_to_review.description: Button that adds a personal entry to the review queue. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_unarchive.description: Button that restores an archived personal entry. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_archive.description: Button that archives a personal entry. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_added_to_review.description: Status after a personal entry was added to the review queue. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_not_added_to_review.message: No new review card was added.
capture_not_added_to_review.description: Status when adding to review created no new card. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_selected_language.description: Line naming the language of the selected text. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_language_unknown.description: Fallback shown after "Selected language:" when the language is not known. Lowercase. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_load_failed.message: $ERROR$ You can retry this page or cancel the capture.
capture_load_failed.description: Status when loading the capture draft failed; $ERROR$ is the reason, a full sentence. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_saved_archived.message: This entry already exists in your archive. Unarchive it below to use it.
capture_saved_archived.description: Status after saving an entry that matches an archived one. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_saved_duplicate.description: Status after saving an entry that already exists. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_saved_review_only.message: Saved as a review-only personal entry.
capture_saved_review_only.description: Status after saving an entry that can only be reviewed. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_saved.message: Saved as a personal entry. It was not added to review.
capture_saved.description: Status after saving a new personal entry. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_cancelled.description: Status after the capture was cancelled. Capture page (capture.html).

capture_export_done.description: Status after the personal entries file was downloaded. Capture page (capture.html).

backup_title.description: Browser tab title of the learning backup page. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_intro.message: Keep your old unpacked installation and its profile intact. Update that installation to a version with this page, export there, then open this page in the separate new installation. Do not remove the old one until you have checked your restored review queue.
backup_intro.description: Introductory paragraph explaining the two-installation backup procedure. "Unpacked installation" means an extension loaded from a folder. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_export_heading.description: Heading of the export section. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_export_description.message: Download supported learning progress, personal entries, generated packs and learning preferences. Export only reads local state.
backup_export_description.description: Paragraph describing what the export contains. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_export_blocked.message: An unverified card from an old or removed language pack blocks the whole backup. The old installation and its history stay intact; this tool cannot safely include that card or import part of the history.
backup_export_blocked.description: Paragraph warning that one unverified card blocks the whole export. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_export_button.description: Button that downloads the backup file. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_import_heading.message: Import into a fresh learning profile
backup_import_heading.description: Heading of the import section. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_import_description.message: Choose a backup file from your computer. Import is available only when this installation has no meaningful learning progress and no Gemini key. Initialized defaults are okay. Existing progress, generated packs or an unknown storage format are conflicts; this page cannot merge or replace them.
backup_import_description.description: Paragraph explaining when import is allowed. Gemini is a product name. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_file_label.description: Label of the file chooser for the backup file. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_preview_button.description: Button that validates the chosen file and shows a summary. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_check_heading.description: Heading of the preview summary shown before importing. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_excluded.message: Excluded: Gemini keys, model/cache/quota data, site choices and host permissions, page text and URLs, pending captures, introduction reservations, reveal and inline tickets. Import never grants a host, enables a site, or calls Gemini. Re-enter a key and choose sites separately afterward.
backup_excluded.description: Note in the preview listing what a backup never contains or does. Gemini is a product name. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_confirm.message: $INPUT$ I checked this preview and want to import into this fresh learning profile.
backup_confirm.description: Checkbox label confirming the import. $INPUT$ stands for the checkbox itself and must stay in the message exactly once. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_import_button.description: Button that performs the import once the preview is confirmed. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_connection_ended.message: This backup page connection ended. Reload the page before importing.
backup_connection_ended.description: Status when the page's link to the background worker was lost. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_unavailable.description: Error when the background worker gave no usable reply. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_failed.description: Error shown when an action fails without a specific reason. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_source_version.description: Preview line naming the extension version that wrote the backup; $VERSION$ may be a question mark when unknown. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_languages_none.description: Shown after "Languages:" in the preview when the backup lists no languages. Lowercase. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_counts.message: Languages: $LANGUAGES$ · Generated packs: $PACKS$ · Review cards: $CARDS$ · Personal entries: $ENTRIES$.
backup_counts.description: Preview line with the backup's contents. $LANGUAGES$ is a comma-separated list; the counts may be a question mark when unknown. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_preferences.message: Learning preferences: language $LANGUAGE$, level $LEVEL$, gradual $GRADUAL$, new words/day $NEW_WORDS$, density $DENSITY$, inline recall $RECALL$.
backup_preferences.description: Preview line listing the learning preferences stored in the backup. Values are settings such as on, off or numbers. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_preferences_retention.message: Learning preferences: language $LANGUAGE$, level $LEVEL$, gradual $GRADUAL$, new words/day $NEW_WORDS$, density $DENSITY$, inline recall $RECALL$, target recall $RETENTION$.
backup_preferences_retention.description: Same as the plain preferences line, with the target recall rate added at the end. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_measurements.message: Learning measurements: $REVIEWS$ logged reviews, exposure counts for $WORDS$ words.
backup_measurements.description: Preview line counting logged reviews and exposure counts in the backup. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_measurements_omitted.message: Learning measurements: $REVIEWS$ logged reviews, exposure counts for $WORDS$ words. Left out, because the exporter's size limit was reached, the words are not in this backup's word lists or personal vocabulary, or they are guess-first answers, which backups do not carry yet: $OMITTED_REVIEWS$ reviews or guesses and exposure counts for $OMITTED_WORDS$ words.
backup_measurements_omitted.description: Same as the measurements line, followed by a second sentence counting what the export had to leave out. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_choose_preview.message: Choose Preview backup to validate the selected file.
backup_choose_preview.description: Status after a file is chosen; "Preview backup" names the button and should match its translation. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_not_prepared.message: The backup could not be prepared.
backup_not_prepared.description: Error when the export produced no file. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_downloaded.message: Learning backup downloaded. Keep the file private and the old installation intact.
backup_downloaded.description: Status after the backup file was downloaded. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_choose_file.message: Choose a learning backup JSON file first.
backup_choose_file.description: Error when Preview is pressed with no file chosen. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_too_large.message: The backup file is over the 1 MiB limit.
backup_too_large.description: Error when the chosen file is larger than one mebibyte. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_port_unavailable.message: The backup page connection is unavailable. Reload this page.
backup_port_unavailable.description: Error when the page cannot reach the background worker. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_preview_incomplete.description: Error when the worker's preview reply was missing parts. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_preview_validated.message: Preview validated. Import requires your confirmation and a fresh target check.
backup_preview_validated.description: Status after a backup file passed validation. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_import_unconfirmed.message: Import was not confirmed. Preview again.
backup_import_unconfirmed.description: Error when the worker did not confirm the import. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_already_imported.message: This exact backup was already imported. No progress changed.
backup_already_imported.description: Status when the same backup had been imported before. Learning backup page (backup.html).

backup_imported.message: Learning progress imported. Open review to check it, then enter your key and choose sites separately.
backup_imported.description: Status after a successful import. Learning backup page (backup.html).

guess_label.description: Screen-reader name of the guess-first panel, which offers a few possible meanings of a woven word.

guess_prompt.description: Prompt at the top of the guess-first panel; the target-language word follows it.

guess_dismiss.description: Button that closes the guess-first panel without answering.

guess_correct.description: Shown before the word and its meaning after a correct guess in the guess-first panel.

guess_incorrect.description: Shown before the word and its meaning after a wrong guess in the guess-first panel.

options_guess_label.description: Settings checkbox label for the opt-in guess-first step on new words.

options_guess_hint.message: On a word's first few encounters, hovering asks you to pick its meaning from a few options before showing it.
options_guess_hint.description: One-line explanation under the Guess first setting.

progress_measure_guess_title.description: Title of a measurement in the "Is this working?" list on My words: how often the first guess at a word's meaning was right.

progress_measure_guess_value_one.message: $PERCENT$ of first guesses were right ($COUNT$ word).
progress_measure_guess_value_one.description: Result of the first-guess accuracy measurement, singular. $1 is the number of words guessed, $2 a percentage.

progress_measure_guess_value_other.message: $PERCENT$ of first guesses were right ($COUNT$ words).
progress_measure_guess_value_other.description: Result of the first-guess accuracy measurement, plural. $1 is the number of words guessed, $2 a percentage.

progress_measure_guess_few_one.message: Not enough data yet: $COUNT$ word guessed; 10 are needed.
progress_measure_guess_few_one.description: First-guess accuracy with too little data, singular. $1 is the number of words guessed so far.

progress_measure_guess_few_other.message: Not enough data yet: $COUNT$ words guessed; 10 are needed.
progress_measure_guess_few_other.description: First-guess accuracy with too little data, plural. $1 is the number of words guessed so far.

progress_measure_guess_why.message: Guessing before seeing the meaning turns a sighting into a retrieval. Very low accuracy means the options give too little to go on.
progress_measure_guess_why.description: Explanation under the first-guess accuracy measurement.

progress_measure_guess_recall_title.description: Title of a measurement comparing next-day recall of words that were guessed first with words that were not.

progress_measure_guess_recall_value.message: $GUESSED$ for guessed words ($GUESSEDCOUNT$ reviews), $OTHER$ for other words ($OTHERCOUNT$ reviews).
progress_measure_guess_recall_value.description: Result of the guess recall comparison. $1 and $3 are percentages, $2 and $4 numbers of reviews.

progress_measure_guess_recall_few.message: Not enough data yet: $GUESSEDCOUNT$ next-day reviews of guessed words and $OTHERCOUNT$ of other words; 10 of each are needed.
progress_measure_guess_recall_few.description: Guess recall comparison with too little data. $1 and $2 are numbers of reviews so far.

progress_measure_guess_recall_why.message: If guessed words are recalled no better than other words, the guess step is not helping. Hovered words can differ from the rest, so this is a hint, not proof.
progress_measure_guess_recall_why.description: Explanation under the guess recall comparison.
